**Finding submitted: T4C — deviation (fallback target).**

- **Notice/exit rights (already met):** Section 4.1 (p0024) gives either Party a 90-day written-notice exit against a one-year auto-renewing term. That satisfies the fallback notice window for us, and HDI's right functions as end-of-term non-renewal on 90 days' notice — the renewal mechanic is a RENEWAL issue, not a Vendor mid-term convenience right, so I did not double-flag it.
- **Failure:** Section 4.2(a) (p0026) imposes an uncapped Termination Payment on *any* termination by us — 12 months' Net Sales less $800,000, halved — which can dwarf three months of fees and turns our convenience exit into a penalty.
- **Cure:** a single surgical proviso capping the Termination Payment at three months of the fees payable under Section 3.1, leaving the "if any" and quarterly instalment machinery in 4.2(b)–(c) intact and coherent against the capped amount.
- I did not push the preferred 30-day/pro-rata-refund package, which would require rewriting the whole Section 4 bargain.
